subject_rule: Research fellowships and PhD scholarships are open to any discipline (the funder writes 'postgraduate researchers in any discipline', 'early-career researchers from all academic fields' and 'a master's degree in any academic field'); the art scholarship for a first Master's is limited to art students in music, visual arts and other artistic domains such as dance, acting and writing, at Swiss art schools and conservatories, and only for applicants from a limited number of countries.

programmes.name: Music (Master in Arts)
programmes.detail: Art scholarship for a first Master's degree at a Swiss art school or conservatory; portfolio for music is a recording of three different styles (composers submit scores). Swiss art schools and conservatories named by the funder for the art scholarship: HES-SO, Bern University of the Arts (HKB-BFH), FHNW, OST, Lucerne University of Applied Sciences and Arts (HSLU), SUPSI, Conservatorio della Svizzera italiana, Zurich University of the Arts (ZHdK)
programmes.source_text: Art Portfolio ... in the field of music

programmes.name: Visual arts (Master in Arts)
programmes.detail: Art scholarship for a first Master's degree at a Swiss art school; portfolio of three pieces of artwork with sketches. Swiss art schools and conservatories named by the funder for the art scholarship: HES-SO, Bern University of the Arts (HKB-BFH), FHNW, OST, Lucerne University of Applied Sciences and Arts (HSLU), SUPSI, Conservatorio della Svizzera italiana, Zurich University of the Arts (ZHdK)
programmes.source_text: in the field of visual arts

programmes.name: Other artistic domains, for example dance, acting, writing (Master in Arts)
programmes.detail: Art scholarship for a first Master's degree at a Swiss art school or conservatory; portfolio as a link or QR code. Swiss art schools and conservatories named by the funder for the art scholarship: HES-SO, Bern University of the Arts (HKB-BFH), FHNW, OST, Lucerne University of Applied Sciences and Arts (HSLU), SUPSI, Conservatorio della Svizzera italiana, Zurich University of the Arts (ZHdK)
programmes.source_text: in other artistic domains (e.g., dance, acting, writing)

notes: The funder publishes no list of Master or PhD programme names: the PhD and research fellowship are open to any discipline and are tied to a Swiss supervisor, not to a programme. Only the three art domains of the art scholarship are named as subject areas, so 3 rows are recorded at master level (all of what the source names) and none at doctorate level.
any_subject is true because of the research fellowship and PhD scholarship (doctorate level); the master-level art scholarship is the one limited exception and is limited to artistic fields.

The funder also lists the 14 universities and research institutes plus the universities of applied sciences and other institutions that host research and PhD scholarships (University of Basel, Bern, Fribourg, Geneva, Lausanne, Lucerne, Neuchatel, St. Gallen, Zurich, Universita della Svizzera italiana, EPFL, ETH Zurich, ETH Domain institutes PSI, WSL, Empa, Eawag, IHEID, HES-SO, BFH, FHNW, OST, FHGR, HSLU, SUPSI, ZHAW, universities of teacher education, UniDistance Suisse, SFUVET, SFISM).
